en: Colorized early 20th‑century postcard showing the Catholic Upper Gymnasium in Brassó (Brașov), Transylvania. The school complex with a church steeple stands before a wooded park, with a mountain and hilltop fort behind. Reverse side has the Hungarian heading 'LEVELEZŐ‑LAP', a green 5 fillér Hungarian stamp cancelled 'BRASSÓ', and an address to Hermannstadt/Nagyszeben; the picture side bears a handwritten German message.
